---
title: "Building an ROC curve"
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

This explorer uses the TIT-based high-CO logistic model on the training set.
Every observed score threshold produces one point on the ROC curve.

::: {.callout-tip}
## What to watch

Start with a very high threshold: no observations receive a high-CO label, so
the curve begins at `(0, 0)`. As the threshold decreases, the model labels more
observations positive. True positives move the point upward; false positives
move it rightward.
:::

```{=html}
<div id="roc-threshold-builder" class="clt-explorer roc-threshold-builder" aria-label="Interactive ROC curve builder">
  <div class="clt-controls roc-threshold-controls" aria-label="ROC threshold control">
    <label>
      <span>Threshold position</span>
      <input id="roc-threshold-slider" type="range" min="0" value="0">
      <output id="roc-threshold-value" for="roc-threshold-slider">τ = ∞</output>
    </label>
  </div>

  <div class="clt-buttons" aria-label="ROC animation controls">
    <button id="roc-play" type="button" class="regression-sampling-primary">Play</button>
    <button id="roc-step" type="button">Next point</button>
    <button id="roc-reset" type="button">Reset</button>
  </div>

  <p id="roc-status" class="clt-status tabular-nums" aria-live="polite"></p>

  <figure class="clt-plot roc-threshold-plot">
    <figcaption>Training ROC curve · final AUC = 0.866</figcaption>
    <svg id="roc-threshold-chart" role="img" aria-label="Training receiver operating characteristic curve being drawn as the threshold decreases"></svg>
  </figure>
</div>
```

The animation steps through all distinct model-score thresholds in descending
order. The slider lets you stop at any individual ROC point. Its values are
not evenly spaced: each one is a predicted probability at which at least one
assigned label changes.

:0.92651917,"fp":10448,"tp":9255},{"threshold":0.069964757866,"fpr":0.66713305,"tpr":0.92691961,"fp":10490,"tp":9259},{"threshold":0.069215630416,"fpr":0.67044009,"tpr":0.92762038,"fp":10542,"tp":9266},{"threshold":0.06847393348,"fpr":0.67781735,"tpr":0.92892181,"fp":10658,"tp":9279},{"threshold":0.067739605959,"fpr":0.69079115,"tpr":0.93082391,"fp":10862,"tp":9298},{"threshold":0.067012586987,"fpr":0.72449758,"tpr":0.93803184,"fp":11392,"tp":9370},{"threshold":0.066292815931,"fpr":0.80443907,"tpr":0.95895485,"fp":12649,"tp":9579},{"threshold":0.065580232404,"fpr":0.9095014,"tpr":0.98678546,"fp":14301,"tp":9857},{"threshold":0.064874776266,"fpr":0.96139659,"tpr":0.99689659,"fp":15117,"tp":9958},{"threshold":0.064176387627,"fpr":0.98467311,"tpr":0.99929923,"fp":15483,"tp":9982},{"threshold":0.063485006856,"fpr":0.99548461,"tpr":0.99959956,"fp":15653,"tp":9985},{"threshold":0.062800574585,"fpr":0.99904604,"tpr":0.99989989,"fp":15709,"tp":9988},{"threshold":0.062123031711,"fpr":0.99968201,"tpr":1.0,"fp":15719,"tp":9989},{"threshold":0.061452319402,"fpr":0.99980921,"tpr":1.0,"fp":15721,"tp":9989},{"threshold":0.060788379102,"fpr":0.99987281,"tpr":1.0,"fp":15722,"tp":9989},{"threshold":0.060131152532,"fpr":0.9999364,"tpr":1.0,"fp":15723,"tp":9989},{"threshold":0.0594805817,"fpr":1.0,"tpr":1.0,"fp":15724,"tp":9989}]};
  const points = roc.points;
  const slider = root.querySelector("#roc-threshold-slider");
  const thresholdValue = root.querySelector("#roc-threshold-value");
  const status = root.querySelector("#roc-status");
  const chart = root.querySelector("#roc-threshold-chart");
  const playButton = root.querySelector("#roc-play");
  const stepButton = root.querySelector("#roc-step");
  const resetButton = root.querySelector("#roc-reset");

  slider.max = String(points.length - 1);

  let pointIndex = 0;
  let playing = false;
  let animationFrame = null;
  let lastFrameTime = 0;

  function svgElement(tagName, attributes = {}) {
    const element = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", tagName);
    Object.entries(attributes).forEach(([name, value]) => element.setAttribute(name, value));
    return element;
  }

  function addText(svg, text, x, y, attributes = {}) {
    const element = svgElement("text", { x, y, ...attributes });
    element.textContent = text;
    svg.append(element);
  }

  function scale(value, domain, range) {
    return range[0] + ((value - domain[0]) / (domain[1] - domain[0])) * (range[1] - range[0]);
  }

  function formatThreshold(threshold) {
    return threshold === null ? "∞" : threshold.toFixed(4);
  }

  function formatRate(rate) {
    if (rate === 0 || rate === 1) return rate.toFixed(3);
    return rate < 0.01 ? rate.toFixed(4) : rate.toFixed(3);
  }

  function draw() {
    const width = Math.round(chart.getBoundingClientRect().width) || 640;
    const compact = width < 480;
    const margin = compact
      ? { top: 16, right: 18, bottom: 50, left: 58 }
      : { top: 20, right: 26, bottom: 58, left: 68 };
    const plotSize = Math.max(1, width - margin.left - margin.right);
    const height = plotSize + margin.top + margin.bottom;
    const plotRight = margin.left + plotSize;
    const plotBottom = margin.top + plotSize;
    const x = value => scale(value, [0, 1], [margin.left, plotRight]);
    const y = value => scale(value, [0, 1], [plotBottom, margin.top]);
    const current = points[pointIndex];

    chart.replaceChildren();
    chart.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 " + width + " " + height);
    chart.setAttribute("width", String(width));
    chart.setAttribute("height", String(height));
    chart.setAttribute("preserveAspectRatio", "xMidYMid meet");

    const title = svgElement("title", {
      id: "roc-threshold-chart-title"
    });
    title.textContent = "Training receiver operating characteristic curve";
    const description = svgElement("desc", {
      id: "roc-threshold-chart-description"
    });
    description.textContent = "The chart shows false positive rate on the horizontal axis and true positive rate on the vertical axis. The curve grows as the classification threshold decreases.";
    chart.append(title, description);
    chart.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", "roc-threshold-chart-title roc-threshold-chart-description");

    chart.append(svgElement("rect", {
      x: margin.left,
      y: margin.top,
      width: plotRight - margin.left,
      height: plotBottom - margin.top,
      class: "roc-threshold-frame"
    }));

    [0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1].forEach(tick => {
      const xPosition = x(tick);
      const yPosition = y(tick);
      chart.append(svgElement("line", {
        x1: xPosition,
        y1: margin.top,
        x2: xPosition,
        y2: plotBottom,
        class: "roc-threshold-grid"
      }));
      chart.append(svgElement("line", {
        x1: margin.left,
        y1: yPosition,
        x2: plotRight,
        y2: yPosition,
        class: "roc-threshold-grid"
      }));
      addText(chart, tick.toFixed(1), xPosition, plotBottom + 20, {
        class: "roc-threshold-tick",
        "text-anchor": "middle"
      });
      addText(chart, tick.toFixed(1), margin.left - 9, yPosition + 4, {
        class: "roc-threshold-tick",
        "text-anchor": "end"
      });
    });

    chart.append(svgElement("line", {
      x1: x(0), y1: y(0), x2: x(1), y2: y(1), class: "roc-threshold-random"
    }));

    const pathData = points
      .slice(0, pointIndex + 1)
      .map((point, index) => (index === 0 ? "M" : "L") + x(point.fpr).toFixed(2) + " " + y(point.tpr).toFixed(2))
      .join(" ");
    chart.append(svgElement("path", {
      d: pathData,
      class: "roc-threshold-curve"
    }));

    chart.append(svgElement("circle", {
      cx: x(current.fpr),
      cy: y(current.tpr),
      r: 5.5,
      class: "roc-threshold-current"
    }));

    addText(chart, "Random classifier", x(0.79), y(0.74), {
      class: "roc-threshold-reference-label",
      "text-anchor": "middle"
    });
    addText(chart, "False positive rate (FPR)", (margin.left + plotRight) / 2, height - 11, {
      class: "roc-threshold-axis-title",
      "text-anchor": "middle"
    });
    const yTitleX = 18;
    const yTitleY = (margin.top + plotBottom) / 2;
    addText(chart, "True positive rate (TPR)", yTitleX, yTitleY, {
      class: "roc-threshold-axis-title",
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      transform: "rotate(-90 " + yTitleX + " " + yTitleY + ")"
    });

    thresholdValue.value = "τ = " + formatThreshold(current.threshold);
    thresholdValue.textContent = "τ = " + formatThreshold(current.threshold);
    status.textContent = "τ = " + formatThreshold(current.threshold)
      + " · FPR = " + formatRate(current.fpr)
      + " · TPR = " + formatRate(current.tpr)
      + " · TP = " + current.tp.toLocaleString()
      + " · FP = " + current.fp.toLocaleString();
  }

  function update(index) {
    pointIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(points.length - 1, index));
    slider.value = String(pointIndex);
    draw();
  }

  function stop() {
    playing = false;
    if (animationFrame !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
    animationFrame = null;
    playButton.textContent = pointIndex >= points.length - 1 ? "Replay" : "Play";
  }

  function animate(timestamp) {
    if (!playing) return;
    if (timestamp - lastFrameTime >= 14) {
      update(pointIndex + 1);
      lastFrameTime = timestamp;
    }
    if (pointIndex >= points.length - 1) {
      stop();
      return;
    }
    animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  playButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (playing) {
      stop();
      return;
    }
    if (pointIndex >= points.length - 1) update(0);
    playing = true;
    playButton.textContent = "Pause";
    lastFrameTime = 0;
    animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  });

  stepButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    stop();
    update(pointIndex + 1);
  });

  resetButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    stop();
    update(0);
  });

  slider.addEventListener("input", () => {
    stop();
    update(Number.parseInt(slider.value, 10));
  });

  new ResizeObserver(draw).observe(chart);
  update(0);
})();
</script>
